payload.title: Record every human Reference accept or reject as a label, human decisions only
payload.description: Only explicit editor decisions (accept; reject with out_of_scope or policy_exclusion) become labels with editor and time. Agent-found, unreviewed and classifier-made decisions never become labels. A reversed decision retires its old label. See docs from design note self-training-cyclotron-design.md (reviewReferenceCuration mutation, reference_policy.py:71-80).
